name: Feed plan

entryPoints.label: Pen feed value in the pen header
Feeding block of a pig record

addsTo.what: Pen feed value in each pen header

flow: tap End date or Add note

notes.purpose: Read what a pen is fed today: formula, delivery, the pen's daily total and each pig's share, then adjust it.

elements.name: Daily feed and pig rows

states.when: Pen mode is trough or station
states.shows: Total kg/day plus a row per pig
"Ad-lib", no pig rows (see feed-plan.adlib)
Feed +10% / Feed held / No feed, joined with " · "
"Follow curve"
No formula label; pigs read "No feeding plan recorded" on their own page

elements.logic: Pen total = sum of every pig's allowance today: base x factor, the held amount, or 0 if stopped. Pig amount e.g. base 2.4 x 1.1 = 2.64, shown rounded to one decimal. Pig count in the title is all pigs of the pen.

elements.name: Card · formula and delivery
elements.logic: Formula name and a label from the pen's feeding mode. Feed is guidance, not a completion checklist: no Record as done, no refill or delivery log.

edge: Pen with mode "unknown": no formula label, pigs show "No feeding plan recorded" on their own page.
issues: The pig row shows the amount to one decimal while the editor shows two (2.6 against 2.64), so the same number reads differently on two screens.
"Formula due" on the walk list has no explanation here: nothing on this page tells the worker what formula change is due or when.
The page shows only formula, mode, kg; the feed brand, supplier and nutrition proposed in ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS are not drawn (unclear: whether the pen page or only the pig page should carry them).

screens.name: Pen feeding · ad-lib
screens.zh: 栏位饲喂 · 自由采食

notes.purpose: An ad-lib pen has no daily allowance, so the page says so and the editor is refused.

elements.name: Daily feed and Adjust feed

states.shows: "Ad-lib" replaces the kg total, no pig rows; Adjust feed opens the editor, which answers "Feed adjustment unavailable · Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance."

elements.rule: Ad-lib formula and timing are read-only; no feeding-completion event is created.

edge: Boars and piglets (animal-types preset) are in ad-lib pens as well.
issues: Adjust feed is offered and always answers "unavailable"; it could be absent or disabled with the reason.
No feeder low or hopper information is drawn.

notes.purpose: All three pens are ticked: the Actions sheet opens on its Pens tab, whose only rows are Pen note and Feed.

elements.name: Pens tab
elements.shows: Actions · 3 pens · 7 pigs; scope switch Pigs 7 | Pens 3

states.shows: Rows Pen note and Feed only; footer holds only Back
That tab is disabled

elements.logic: Pen note writes the same note to every selected pen. Feed opens the editor over the pigs of the ticked pens; ad-lib pigs appear as blocked rows. Pigs not ticked inside a ticked pen still count: opening from pens captures the pens' current pigs.
elements.rule: A fault needs one pen, so equipment fault reporting asks for a single pen.

issues: The row is named "Feed" with "for these pigs" under a tab called Pens: pens and pigs mean the same row.
No Pens-tab row reaches equipment faults though the pen chooser exists in the code.

notes.purpose: Change the daily feed of one or many pigs (a pen, ticked pigs, ticked pens) in one move.

elements.name: Feeding mode
elements.shows: Follow curve | Hold amount | Stop feed

states.when: Default; no hold or stop on the pigs
states.shows: Percentage from -50 to +50 of the base curve

states.when: Chosen, or every pig already has a held amount
states.shows: Every pig keeps today's kg as a fixed amount; % box disabled ("Daily amounts stay fixed")

states.when: Chosen, or every pig already stopped
states.shows: 0.0 kg/day; box disabled ("No feed · 0.0 kg/day")

states.when: Opened over pigs with different factors
states.shows: Box shows placeholder "Mixed", hint "Choose one % for all pigs"

states.when: Opened and only an end date or note edited
states.shows: Plan left as is; Save logs "Plan unchanged"
Back to the curve at 0%; Save logs "Reset to curve"

states.when: All ad-lib, dead or no plan
states.shows: "Feed adjustment unavailable" and the reason

elements.logic: Changing mode resets the percentage to 0 when mixed or out of range. The percentage REPLACES each pig's existing adjustment. Hold amount fixes today's kg; later curve growth no longer applies until reset. Reset = follow curve, 0%, no end date.

elements.name: Percentage input
elements.logic: Slider moves in 5% steps, the box accepts any decimal; they stay in step. Starts at the current factor of the target (only if all pigs share it).
elements.rule: Blank or outside -50 to +50 disables Save.

elements.name: Pig row

states.shows: Current → New (two decimals) and the change: "+0.3 kg/day" or "Unchanged"

states.when: Pending change removes or replaces it
states.shows: Tag struck through with "Removed or replaced on Save"
"Ad-lib feeding has no fixed daily allowance" / "Pig has died" / "No feeding plan recorded"; never changed

elements.logic: Scope in the title is the pig count; a pen entry shows its pig count, not the pen name.

elements.name: Optional chips
elements.logic: Chip shows "Until 15 Sep" or the note text; an x clears it. With one pig targeted, the existing end date and reason are prefilled.
elements.rule: End date must be today or later. When it passes, the prototype does nothing.

elements.name: Save
elements.rule: Enabled when at least one pig can be adjusted AND (a mode other than keep, or a changed end date / note) AND percent within -50 to +50 AND any end date is today or later. Writes to each eligible pig, logs one "Feed plan changed" per pig ("old → new kg/day · +10% of curve · Until date · reason"), returns to the walk. Ad-lib pigs in a selection stay unchanged.

issues: Save silently ends the link between a body-condition finding (Thin) and its feed adjustment; Resolve says so, this screen does not.
Follow curve, percent 0 and Reset all return to the curve: three ways back.
The default Save reason "Feed plan" shows as the reason on the pig's Feed tag.
From a pen header the scope reads "3 pigs"; the pen being changed is not named.
A pen-total preview (feedPreview) and a Feed breakdown sheet exist in code but are not drawn or opened.
The screen carries too much: mode, percent, slider, chips and a per-pig table all state one decision.

screens.name: End date and note for a feed change

notes.purpose: Optional: until when the change holds, and a free note.

elements.name: End date and note forms
elements.shows: Date field with Remove date; text area with Remove note
elements.rule: Date accepts today (12 Sep 2026) or later; earlier is refused. Save stays disabled until the value differs from the saved one. Saving only a note or date turns on Save in the editor even when mode and percent are unchanged.

issues: The end date is held on the pig as a plain date; when it passes, nothing returns the pig to the curve.

notes.purpose: Read one pig's feeding today and the base curve it comes from.

elements.name: Feeding block
elements.shows: Gestation 1 · Included in pen allocation · 2.6 kg/day · tags

states.shows: Feeding block plus Base curve chart
Block only: "Ad-lib", "No fixed ration", no chart
"No feeding plan recorded."

elements.logic: Context: "Station-fed" for station pens, "Included in pen allocation" for trough pens. The tag carries its reason: the saved reason or the body-condition band ("Thin · mild"); Feed held and No feed carry their own kg line.

elements.name: Base curve
elements.logic: Points are made-up base kg per day around the pig's base amount; vertical range = min/max rounded outward by 0.2. Caption "kg/day · before individual adjustments". The curve source ("Sample farm curve") is in the data but not drawn.

rules: Keep the feeding program (the animal's plan) distinct from the feed formula (the product).
issues: The page cannot adjust anything; the way to change a pig's feed is the Actions sheet or a finding.
Supplier, brand, energy, protein and lysine proposed in ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS are not shown.
The Feeding block repeats the one on the pig record.

screens.name: On the list · pen feed increased

notes.purpose: Shows how a +10% change on the whole pen reads on the walk list.

elements.name: Pen feed value and feed tags
elements.shows: 8.1 kg; Feed +10% on every C1 pig

states.when: All three C1 pigs carry factor 1.1
states.shows: Pen value (7.6 x 1.1 = 8.14) shown to one decimal; Feed lens count rises to 5

elements.logic: Tag delta = (factor - 1) x 100, one decimal, sign shown.

issues: A pen-wide change repeats as a tag on each pig row instead of once at the pen.

screens.name: On the list · pen feed decreased

notes.purpose: Shows how a -5% change on the whole pen reads on the walk list.

elements.name: Pen feed value and feed tags
elements.shows: 7.0 kg; Feed -5% on every C1 pig

states.when: All three C1 pigs carry factor 0.95

elements.logic: Tag delta = (factor - 1) x 100, one decimal, sign shown.

issues: Same repetition as the increased state; a decrease uses the same neutral tag as an increase.

screens.name: On the list · pen feed held

notes.purpose: Shows how a held amount reads on the walk list.

elements.name: Pen feed value and feed tags
elements.shows: 7.6 kg; Feed held on every C1 pig

states.when: Every C1 pig has a fixed daily amount equal to what it received before
states.shows: Pen value unchanged; tag "Feed held", the kg only in its tooltip ("2.6 kg/day · fixed amount")

issues: "Feed held" does not say how much or until when; the amount is only in a tooltip.
